name: beer-game
description: Multiplayer Beer Distribution Game — demonstrates the supply-chain bullwhip effect.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm --prefix client exec tsc -- -b
